name: Impeccable Design Director
description: Transforms timid frontend code into award-winning, production-grade craft. Includes overdrive, audit, polish, and anti-pattern detectors.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description: Deep browser automation, network request interception, console log introspection, and live DOM tree exploration for AI coding agents.

name: LCP Performance Profiler
description: Pinpoints and resolves Largest Contentful Paint bottlenecks, sub-optimal font flashes (FOUT/FOIT), and unoptimized media delivery paths.

name: Accessibility (a11y) Auditor
description: Audits keyboard navigation traps, ARIA landmark hierarchies, focus ring visibility, color contrast math, and tap target geometry.

name: V8 Heap & Memory Hunter
description: Diagnoses JavaScript heap retention trees, detached DOM nodes, uncleaned event listeners, and runaway closures in long-lived sessions.

name: Editorial Motion Kit
description: Curated physics springs, staggered text reveals, shared layout morphs, and micro-interaction hooks tuned for editorial publications.

name: Parchment Token Preset
description: Claude-inspired warm parchment palette, ink hierarchy, restrained radius scale, and featherweight soft shadows without AI-slop.

name: Headless E2E Synthetics
description: Resilient cross-browser regression test runner with auto-waiting assertions, visual diffing, and zero-flakiness network stubbing.

name: Semantic Git Sculptor
description: Standardizes conventional commits, squashes messy agent experiment checkpoints, and enforces clean branch topologies prior to PR.

name: Dependency Weight Inspector
description: Instantly queries npm package sizes, tree-shaking efficacy, side-effect flags, and gzip overhead before you run npm install.

name: Vercel Edge Deploy Guard
description: Monitors deployment preview states, checks edge function payload limits, and inspects build logs via official Vercel CLI.

name: TypeScript Total Reset
description: Ruleset for stricter TypeScript built-ins: fixes JSON.parse, fetch, array.filter(Boolean), and Object.entries type safety.
